implementation_status: partial; ability gates and explicit active-buff lifetimes; native AI disorientation and champion stun are not implemented

sources.support: Historical 4.0.0.1 description: interrupts active abilities and prevents abilities/movement modes; combatants cannot fire. Not a current numerical specification.

current_content_policies.active_state_contract: An interruptible ongoing ability is a buff tagged chorus_d2:suppression_interruptible. Suppression removes all such instances on application, reapplication and later gains. This tag is a content contract, not inferred from a name.
current_content_policies.reapplication: MAX_REMAINING, preserves the first source while the instance exists; exact original-game cross-source refresh attribution is not calibrated.
current_content_policies.duration: Shared buff defaults to 10 s; the acceptance applier explicitly provides 10 / 5 by PVE/PVP mode. Each future producer must provide its own actual duration.
current_content_policies.cancelled_work: Only lifetime-owned work disappears. Detached actions and committed cost remain. No implicit energy refund, restoration of old abilities or global chain cut.
current_content_policies.guardian_weapons: This shared status has no weapon fire/reload denial; native acceptance checks both remain usable.

synthetic_acceptance.active_abilities: Two synthetic Super / Transcendence lifetimes; periodic native healing stands in for ongoing work, with synthetic energy and weapon parameters. No full original Super is claimed.
synthetic_acceptance.world_pvp_duration: Actual 5-second runtime expiry and a newly paid cast after expiry.

All actual Super / Transcendence / movement ability lifetimes and cleanup
